citation_short: Noel et al. (2019), DoC PPS encoding
confidence_basis: Main PDF, OpenDataLoader output, fallback pypdf extraction, targeted methods searches, rendered methods pages, and PMC/Europe PMC supplement checks were reviewed. The paper reports enough static near/far auditory, tactile, condition, ITI, baseline, block, and count information to recreate the DoC and healthy-control EEG PPS profile; exact white-noise source asset/seed and original scripts are not supplied.

profile_recreation_assessment.reason: The study can be recreated as a passive arm-centered near/far audio-tactile EEG profile with white-noise bursts, electrical tactile stimulation, five randomized condition rows, fixed per-block counts, and reported EEG baseline. It is static near/far stimulation, not a looming or front-approach trajectory.

source_checks.scope: Reviewed apparatus, Experiment 1 procedure, Experiment 2 patient procedure, EEG preprocessing, figure methods panel, and analyses for Segment 1-4 values.
Used as primary extraction map for pages 3-4 and checked against fallback extraction and rendered page images.
Searched all pages for white noise, tactile, speaker, near, far, randomized, inter-trial, baseline, block, trial, and supplement terms.
Temporary rendered methods pages were visually checked to verify distances, apparatus, condition rows, ITI, and block/session counts.
PMC/Europe PMC route was checked; the full-text metadata reports no supplementary material for this article.

review_attempts.result: Located methods pages with white-noise auditory bursts, FES tactile stimulation, near/far distances, randomized blocks, ITI, and per-condition counts.
Confirmed the figure caption and apparatus/procedure paragraphs use 5 cm and 75 cm speaker positions with five total conditions.
pypdf confirmed the Segment 1-4 values and clarified that automated low-confidence SOA/catch hits were analysis timings, not task catch trials.
Visually verified the methods figure, randomized-within-block statement, 1.5-2 s uniform ITI, variable patient block counts, and EEG baseline window.
PMC/Europe PMC metadata did not expose supplementary files, so the main PDF is the complete available source for this audit.
Mapped T, ANear, AFar, ATNear, and ATFar rows; synchronous audio-tactile timing; unisensory controls; no catch task; and 50 trials per condition per block.

stimulus_type.value: Auditory stimulation used 50 ms white-noise bursts.
stimulus_type.evidence_note: The apparatus section identifies white noise and its duration.

source_provenance.value: White noise was delivered through Logitech Z120 portable speakers; exact source file, random seed, or script is not supplied.
source_provenance.evidence_note: Speaker model and stimulus class are reported, but not reusable audio assets.

trajectory_count.value: Two static auditory distance positions: near and far.
trajectory_count.evidence_note: The task uses near and far speaker positions rather than motion.

trajectory_path.value: Speakers were placed about 5 cm and 75 cm from the participant's extended stimulated arm in the depth dimension.
trajectory_path.evidence_note: The methods and figure caption report near/far distances anchored to the stimulated arm.

stimulus_duration.value: Auditory bursts lasted 50 ms; tactile FES stimulation also lasted 50 ms.
stimulus_duration.evidence_note: Both auditory and tactile stimulus durations are reported.

stimulus_speed.value: No auditory motion speed applies; this profile used static near/far speakers.

auditory_conditions.value: Auditory near alone, auditory far alone, audio-tactile near, audio-tactile far, plus tactile alone.
auditory_conditions.evidence_note: The procedure and figure caption enumerate the five condition families.

gain_envelope.value: Reported levels were 65.2 dB SPL at near and 64.1 dB SPL at far; no detailed amplitude envelope beyond a 50 ms burst is provided.
gain_envelope.evidence_note: The two distance-specific SPL values are explicitly reported.

renderer_or_apparatus.value: Auditory apparatus was Logitech Z120 portable speakers; tactile stimulation used a MEDEL MOTIONSTIM 8 FES device.
renderer_or_apparatus.evidence_note: The main stimulation hardware is reported.

trial_rows_families.value: Five trial rows per block: tactile alone, auditory near, auditory far, audio-tactile near, and audio-tactile far.
trial_rows_families.evidence_note: The block is defined as five 50-trial condition rows.

condition_intermixing.value: All trials were fully randomized within each block.
condition_intermixing.evidence_note: The procedure reports randomization within blocks.

blocked_or_random_order.value: Healthy participants completed three randomized 250-trial blocks; patients completed variable randomized blocks by clinical availability.
blocked_or_random_order.evidence_note: Healthy and patient block structures are reported separately.

iti_jitter_policy.value: Inter-trial interval was 1.5-2 s with a uniform distribution.
iti_jitter_policy.evidence_note: ITI range and distribution are explicitly reported.

response_window.value: No per-trial behavioral response window applies; participants were instructed to relax with eyes closed during passive EEG stimulation.
response_window.evidence_note: The task is passive and has no response-window rule.

task_sequence_rules.value: Participants kept eyes closed; healthy participants had short breaks between blocks, and patients lay supine at about 130 degrees.
task_sequence_rules.evidence_note: Experiment-specific posture and rest rules are described.

tactile_stimulus.value: 50 ms FES pulses at 35 Hz over extensor digitorum communis, 70 percent motor threshold, 5-11 mA, via Flextrode electrodes.
tactile_stimulus.evidence_note: Site, duration, frequency, calibration rule, current range, and electrodes are reported.

soa_table.value: Audio-tactile trials were synchronous; the study did not manipulate a tactile SOA ladder.
soa_table.evidence_note: The methods state that auditory and tactile stimuli were administered synchronously.

baseline_strategy.value: Tactile-only and auditory-only rows served as unisensory control/baseline rows for multisensory comparisons; EEG used prestimulus baseline correction.
baseline_strategy.evidence_note: The condition design and analyses compare multisensory responses with unisensory controls.

baseline_timing.value: EEG epochs spanned -100 to +500 ms around stimulus onset and were baseline-corrected to the 100 ms prestimulus interval.
baseline_timing.page_or_section: PDF p.4, EEG acquisition and preprocessing
baseline_timing.evidence_note: Epoch and baseline-correction windows are explicitly reported.

catch_trial_type.value: No catch or no-go trials are described; auditory-only rows are unisensory controls rather than behavioral catches.
catch_trial_type.evidence_note: The five rows are passive stimulus conditions.

repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.value: Each 250-trial block contained 50 trials in each of the five condition rows.
repetitions_per_tactile_soa_condition.evidence_note: The per-condition repetition count is stated for each block.

baseline_count.value: Per block, unisensory controls were 50 tactile-only, 50 auditory-near, and 50 auditory-far trials.
baseline_count.evidence_note: Unisensory row counts are part of the five 50-trial block rows.

catch_count.value: No catch/no-go count applies because no catch family is reported.
catch_count.evidence_note: No behavioral catch trials are part of the design.

block_count.value: Healthy participants completed three blocks; patients averaged 3.2 blocks per session, ranging from 1 to 7, with 96 total blocks across 30 sessions.
block_count.evidence_note: Patient session/block variability and healthy block count are reported.

total_trial_count.value: Each block had 250 trials; healthy participants therefore completed three 250-trial blocks, and patient data comprised 96 such blocks.
total_trial_count.evidence_note: The paper reports per-block trials, healthy block count, and patient total blocks.

critical_caveats: The exact white-noise source file, seed, and any stimulus-generation script are not supplied.
The profile is static near/far around the arm, not a looming, receding, or frontal auditory trajectory.
Only distance-specific SPL values are reported; no detailed amplitude envelope is provided beyond the 50 ms burst.
Patient recordings had variable block counts by clinical availability.
This is a passive EEG profile with no behavioral response window or catch task.
next_manual_action: Use this as the high-confidence DoC/static near-far arm protocol source for the Cell Reports Medicine lineage. For missing exact sound assets or scripts, inspect cited lineage papers, but do not infer a looming/frontal trajectory from this paper.
